baseline: Two accepted numbers, republished read-only beside this run's own measurement and neither re-decided: (1) the accepted counter-emission attribution `evaluation/vendored_frontier_counter_emission/ATTRIBUTION.json`, whose cause classes are `c_HYDRATION` and `e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT` only, i.e. LABEL-side causes, and which does not look at how the probe is built; (2) the accepted counter-emission cross-check `results/evaluation/counter_emission_crosscheck/39457963802.json` (accept commit cbda7853, ZERO_DIVERGENCE over 96 comparable quantities), which compares the label stage only. Neither accepted artefact measures the probe's topic anchor, so this hypothesis is not a re-litigation of accepted evidence: it is the first measurement of the RETRIEVAL-side construction of the counter probe.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: on the accepted product's recorded counter-probe queries, whether the topic anchor of an issued counter probe contains a token that the product's own key-term extractor derives from the generative audit's redaction placeholder, and whether the de-redaction counterfactual changes that anchor. It is a RETRIEVAL-side construction measurement of the probe, and it is NOT a measurement of the label-emission stage (that is attributed by frontier-counter-label-emission, already cross-checked in run 39457963802 and NOT re-litigated here), NOT a measurement of counter-authority recall against any frozen known-counter set, NOT a claim about LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND (both stay REPORTED-ONLY), NOT a claim about jurist usefulness or about the map, and NOT a serve recommendation. The reported adversarial-row topicality rates are OBSERVATIONAL — the counterfactual cannot re-run the live retrieval — and are reported with numerator and denominator and no threshold. It lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; packet admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready and owner_decision_required stay false. No universal-174k benchmark is run and no product source file is modified by this instrument.
controls: C1_replay_fidelity — the product's own `plan_adversarial_queries`, run on the bundle's own recorded answer prose, reproduces every recorded probe query byte-for-byte, and the anchor is uniform across all four recorded intents. A failure means the measurement is not faithful to the shipped behaviour and must not be published (exit 2).

C2_blank_prose_yields_no_plan — `plan_adversarial_queries` on a blank answer prose returns an empty plan, i.e. the product's own D4 vacuity guard holds and the anchor really is derived from the answer prose rather than from the question.
C3_clean_bundle_not_flagged — at least one bundle whose answer prose contains no redaction placeholder exists and is not classified CONTAMINATED, so the gate is specific rather than universal.

C4_de_redaction_is_a_no_op_without_the_placeholder — for every bundle whose answer prose contains no redaction placeholder, de-redacting the prose leaves the anchor unchanged, so the attribution to the placeholder cannot be an artefact of the de-redaction step itself.

C5_gate_discriminates_not_merely_detects_placeholder — at least one bundle whose answer prose DOES contain the redaction placeholder exists and is not classified CONTAMINATED, so the gate discriminates on the anchor's content (the mechanism is frequency-dependent) rather than on the mere presence of the placeholder.

exit_code_contract.0: COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_NOT_FALSIFIED — the measurable population is non-empty, all pins held, all five controls passed, and no issued probe's anchor contains a placeholder-derived token
exit_code_contract.1: COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_FALSIFIED — at least one issued probe's anchor contains a placeholder-derived token, and all pins and all five controls held
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS — a pin drifted before or after execution, a non-vacuity control failed, or the measurable population was empty; never a product verdict

frozen_rule: per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: CONTAMINATED iff (recorded_anchor INTERSECT answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER)) is non-empty; NOT_CONTAMINATED otherwise. The run verdict is COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_FALSIFIED iff at least one measured bundle is CONTAMINATED and all five non-vacuity controls pass; COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_NOT_FALSIFIED iff no measured bundle is CONTAMINATED and all five controls pass; ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS iff any control fails, any pin drifts before or after execution, or the measurable population is empty. CONTAMINATED is a set intersection on the product's own tokenisation and stoplist: there is NO count, rate, frequency, share or percentage threshold anywhere in the rule, and none may be introduced after the result is seen. The topicality measures (iii) and (iv) are REPORTED-ONLY and can never change the verdict.
hypothesis: For every bundle of the accepted product population that issued a recorded counter-authority probe, the TOPIC ANCHOR of the issued probe (its first four tokens, which the product's own planner builds as `probe_terms = key_terms[:4] + terms` from the answer prose) contains NO token that the product's own `answer_key_terms` extracts from the generative audit's redaction placeholder `[citation removed: not in retrieved set]`, AND the anchor contains at least one content term of the question that the probe is supposed to attack. FALSIFIED iff at least one issued probe's anchor contains a placeholder-derived token. The claim under test is a product-capability claim: the counter-authority channel must attack the legal proposition of its question; a probe anchored on the redaction placeholder is not a counter-authority search at all.
metric: Per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: (i) the recorded anchor, i.e. the first four whitespace-separated tokens of `provenance.adversarial_retrieval.probes[i]['query']`; (ii) the set intersection of that anchor with `answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER)` computed by the PRODUCT's own code; (iii) the set intersection of that anchor with the question's content terms, a content term being a token of the question under the product's own `bundle_topic_terms` pool rule (`len(token) >= 6`, not in the product's `_ANSWER_STOP`, not a digit); (iv) REPORTED-ONLY, no threshold: the number and rate of the bundle's adversarially discovered rows (`provenance.adversarial_retrieval.new_row_ids`) whose own text (`regeste` + `snippet` + `title`) shares at least one question content term, and the same count against the product's own `bundle_topic_terms` pool; (v) the de-redaction counterfactual, i.e. the anchor recomputed by the product's own `plan_adversarial_queries` from the answer prose with the placeholder occurrences replaced by a space. All numbers are reported with numerator and denominator; no rate is thresholded.
no_thresholds_statement: CONTAMINATED is set intersection on the product's own tokenisation, the product's own stoplist and the product's own placeholder constant. No bar, rubric, threshold, share, ratio, count cut-off, stoplist, tokeniser, projection constant or verdict contract of any frozen suite is read for enforcement, edited, re-derived, re-tuned or paraphrased. RULES_LABEL.json / RULES_GEOMETRY.json / VERDICT_CONTRACT.json are not inputs to this instrument. The topicality measures are REPORTED-ONLY and can never change the verdict. The product's own `answer_key_terms`, `plan_adversarial_queries`, `_ANSWER_STOP`, `tokenize`, `bundle_topic_terms` and `REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER` are used as-is from the accepted mount and are never re-implemented here.
population_definition: Every `*.bundle.json` under the source tree that carries a non-empty `provenance.adversarial_retrieval.probes` list. On the accepted mount this is 14 bundles across 5 packets (38838116453, 38839347028, 39275520116, 39319405429, rebuilt-39027045675). The committed secondary source `results/evaluation/rebuilt_packet_adjudication_39049030442/packet/` is the documented mount-absent fallback and holds 3 bundles (the rebuilt packet); an in-repo re-run with the mount absent therefore measures the smaller committed population and says so in the record. The population is a function of the source tree, not a hand-picked list: bundles without recorded probes are out of scope because they issued no counter probe.

product_handoff: The falsification, if it occurs, is a PRODUCT defect, not an evaluation defect, and the fix belongs to the product lane. The product's counter-authority channel reads the topic anchor from answer prose that the generative audit has already rewritten, so the placeholder tokens compete with real legal vocabulary inside `answer_key_terms`. Two admissible product-side remedies, both outside this lane's write scope: (a) exclude the redaction placeholder from the probe key terms (strip `REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER` from the prose before `answer_key_terms`, or exclude the placeholder's tokens from the candidate set) in `product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py`; or (b) plan the probes from the PRE-redaction prose, i.e. reorder `product/query/pipeline.py` so that `adversarial_retrieval_pass` sees the prose the answer was written from. Remedy (a) is the smaller change and keeps the audit's redaction intact. The evaluation lane's job here ends at the measured, reproducible, falsifiable statement of the defect and its scope.
